sections.heading: Summary
sections.body:
- **What:** A customer-facing app and an owner dashboard that let customers view services and prices, book a slot, and pay in advance with UPI. The salon owner sees the day's bookings and can mark appointments done. Automated WhatsApp reminders are sent one hour before appointments.
- **Who:** Built for **salon owners in Pune** and their customers to reduce no-shows and simplify booking and payment.
- **Why:** To provide a simple digital booking + prepaid payments flow that saves time for owners and gives customers an easy booking experience.
sections.hint: What is being built, for whom, and why, in a few sentences.

sections.heading: Target users
sections.body:
- **Primary users:** Salon owners in Pune (single-salon owners, small chains) who need a simple daily bookings view and basic service/price management.
- **Primary users (customers):** Local customers in Pune who want to browse services, book a slot, and prepay with UPI.
- **Scale/volume:** Initial rollout assumed for a small number of salons (pilot group 5–50). Growth targets to be discussed.
- **Locations:** Pune (localization / language preferences to be confirmed).
sections.hint: Who uses it: roles, personas, how many, where.
iOS, Android, web, backend, admin; minimum OS versions.
sections.body:
- **Customer apps (recommended):** Android and iOS native apps. (Propose Android min: Android 8.0/Oreo; iOS min: iOS 13 — confirm.)
- **Owner dashboard:** Web-based responsive dashboard (works on desktop/tablet browsers). Option to provide a companion PWA for owner mobile access.
- **Backend:** Cloud-hosted REST/GraphQL API and database.
- **Store submission:** Help with Play Store and App Store listings and screenshots.
sections.heading: Platforms

sections.body:
- **View services and prices:** Customers browse salon services and see prices and durations.
- **Book a slot:** Customers pick date/time slot from available calendar and reserve a booking (slot availability checks and concurrency control to avoid double-booking).
- **Pay in advance with UPI:** Prepaid payment flow using UPI; capture transaction id and show receipt.
- **Owner dashboard — today's bookings:** Owner sees a list of that day's bookings with customer name, service, time, payment status.
- **Owner can mark appointments done:** Owner can change booking status to **Done** (or Cancelled) from dashboard.
- **WhatsApp reminder:** Automated WhatsApp reminder sent **1 hour before** appointment (message template configurable).
- **Booking confirmation & receipts:** Immediate confirmation to customer (in-app + WhatsApp or email) after booking and payment.
- **Service management for owner:** Owner can add/edit services and prices (so customers see up-to-date catalogue).
- **Basic user auth & roles:** Customer identity (phone-based) and owner accounts with role-based access control.
- **Admin & logging:** Basic admin account for support, booking logs, and viewing message/send status.
sections.heading: Must-have features
sections.hint: What version one cannot ship without.

sections.body:
- **Loyalty points and referral scheme:** Planned for later (points accrual, redemption, referral codes).
- **Push notifications:** Native push reminders in addition to WhatsApp.
- **Google Calendar sync:** Allow owner or customer to add booking to Google Calendar.
- **Multi-branch / staff assignment:** Support multiple locations or staff schedules (phase 2).
- **Reports & analytics:** Daily revenue, bookings per service, no-show rate dashboard.
- **Waitlist & booking rescheduling flows.**
- **In-app chat or customer support messaging.**
sections.heading: Nice-to-have features
Screens
sections.body:
- **Customer — Services list:** Shows salon name, list of services, price and duration. User can tap a service to book.
- **Customer — Service detail & available slots:** Shows service description, available dates/times for the selected salon.
- **Customer — Slot selection calendar:** Choose date/time; shows slot availability and expected staff (if applicable).
- **Customer — Checkout / UPI payment:** Summarizes booking, collects phone number, initiates UPI payment and shows transaction status.
- **Customer — Booking confirmation:** Shows booking reference, time, service, payment id, and options to add to calendar or share.
- **Customer — My bookings / history:** Upcoming and past bookings with status and receipts.
- **Owner — Dashboard (web):** Today's bookings list with time, customer, service, payment status, and action buttons (Mark Done, Cancel, View details).
- **Owner — Booking detail modal/page:** Full booking info, payment transaction id, notes, and action to mark done or cancel.
- **Owner — Services & prices management:** CRUD UI to add/edit services, price, duration, and visible flag.
- **Owner — Settings:** Business hours, reminder template, WhatsApp sender settings, contact details.
- **Admin — System view:** View all salons, booking logs, message send status, and basic analytics.
sections.hint: Each screen and what it shows and does.

sections.body:
- **Payments (UPI):** Integrate with an Indian UPI-capable payment gateway (examples: Razorpay, Paytm, Cashfree) or implement UPI intent deep-linking. **Decision required:** gateway choice and reconciliation approach.
- **WhatsApp:** Use WhatsApp Business Cloud API (Meta) or a provider like Twilio/360dialog for sending reminders; messages must be template-based and pre-approved.
- **SMS (fallback):** Optional SMS gateway (MSG91/Twilio) for fallback when WhatsApp not available.
- **Email:** Transactional emails via SendGrid/Postmark or SMTP for receipts.
- **Analytics & crash reporting:** Firebase Analytics + Crashlytics (or Google Analytics for web) for usage and errors.
- **Maps (optional):** Google Maps for salon location display and directions if salon addresses are shown.
- **Hosting & DB:** Cloud hosting (AWS/GCP/Azure) and managed DB (Postgres/Cloud SQL).
- **Optional calendar sync:** Google Calendar API for sync/export of appointments.
sections.heading: Integrations
sections.hint: Payments, maps, SMS, email, analytics, third-party APIs.
What is stored, who can see it, how people sign in.
sections.body:
- **Data stored:** Salon profiles (name, address, hours), services catalogue (name, price, duration), bookings (customer name, phone, datetime, service id, status), payment records (UPI transaction id, amount, payment status), reminder logs (WhatsApp send status), and basic audit logs.
- **Who can see what:** Customers see public salon data and their own bookings; salon owners see data for their salon only; admin sees all salons for support.
- **Authentication:** Recommend **phone number + OTP** for customers (minimal friction). Owners sign in with **email + password** and optional 2FA. Admin accounts with stronger controls.
- **Data retention & privacy:** Store personal contact and payment metadata; actual UPI credentials are not stored. Obtain consent for WhatsApp messages and marketing.
- **Backup & export:** Regular backups and CSV export of bookings/payments for owner reconciliation.
sections.heading: Data and authentication

sections.body:
- **Performance:** API responses <300ms for typical requests; booking-write endpoints must handle concurrency and prevent double-booking.
- **Availability:** Target 99.5% uptime for backend; scheduled maintenance windows communicated in advance.
- **Offline:** Owner dashboard should tolerate brief offline periods (local caching) and sync when online; customer booking requires online connectivity for payment.
- **Languages / localisation:** Default English. Recommend adding Marathi/Hindi for Pune users in a later sprint (confirm language preference).
- **Accessibility:** Basic accessibility support (readable fonts, tappable controls, color contrast). Aim for WCAG AA where practical.
- **Security:** TLS for all traffic, encryption at rest for PII, secure storage of API keys, follow PCI/DSS responsibilities via payment gateway (we'll not store card/UPI credentials). Rate limiting and brute-force protection for auth endpoints.
sections.heading: Non-functional requirements
Deliverables
sections.body:
- **Customer apps:** Android and iOS app source and builds (IPA/APK) ready for store submission.
- **Owner dashboard:** Web application source code, deployed instance, and optional PWA packaging.
- **Backend:** API server, database schema, deployment scripts, and cloud infra configuration.
- **Admin panel:** Basic admin interface for support and viewing logs.
- **Integration setup:** WhatsApp Business API configuration instructions, payment gateway setup steps, and test credentials.
- **Source code & docs:** Full source code repo, README, API documentation (OpenAPI/Swagger), deployment runbook, and developer setup guide.
- **QA deliverables:** Test plan, test cases, and QA report for the first release.
- **Store support:** Help preparing Play Store / App Store listings, assets, and submission support.
sections.hint: Apps, backend, admin, source code, store listings, documentation.

sections.heading: Out of scope
sections.body:
- **Loyalty points and referral scheme** (explicitly deferred to later sprints).
- **Full accounting, invoicing, tax filings, or payroll integrations.**
- **POS hardware integration (card readers, printers) or in-salon terminals.**
- **Complex staff rostering, advanced scheduling algorithms, or marketplace multi-salon onboarding flows** (beyond single-salon support unless requested).
- **Marketing automation beyond the single WhatsApp reminder (no email marketing, push drip campaigns in MVP).**

- Do customers need mandatory accounts or allow guest bookings with phone number only?
- Confirm platforms: do you want both Android and iOS at launch, or start with one platform?
- Which UPI/payment gateway do you prefer (Razorpay, Paytm, Cashfree, or direct UPI intent)? Who will handle the payment gateway merchant onboarding?
- WhatsApp provider: do you have an existing WhatsApp Business account / phone number and preference for Meta Cloud API vs Twilio/360dialog?
- Cancellation and refund policy: should customers be allowed to cancel/reschedule from the app and under what rules?
- Do owners need the ability to add multiple staff members and assign bookings to staff in version 1?
- Language preference for the UI in Pune: English only, or add Marathi/Hindi in MVP?
- Expected number of salons and monthly booking volume for sizing the backend (pilot 5–50 assumed; confirm).
- Do you require GST/invoice numbers on receipts at launch?
- Do you want SMS fallback when WhatsApp fails to deliver reminders?
- Do you want automated payout reconciliation to the salon bank account, or will owners reconcile manually with the payment gateway statements?
- Any branding assets, tone, or message templates you want used for WhatsApp reminders and receipts?
- Will the owner manage service/pricing themselves via the dashboard, or should the agency pre-load services for the pilot?
- Are there any regulatory or data residency requirements we must follow beyond standard Indian regulations?
